title: Easton Press The History Of Tom Jones 1979 Collector’s Edition Leather Bound
descriptionText:
This collector's edition of "The History of Tom Jones" by Herman Melville is a must-have for any literature enthusiast. The leather-bound book, published by Easton Press in 1979, is a rare find that belongs in any book collection. The book features 100 Greatest of All Time and is perfect for anyone who loves literature and fiction. 

The book is in great shape and has been well-maintained over the years. It is a unit type book and comes in English language. The book is not personalized and has no California Prop 65 Warning. This book is a perfect addition to any antique or collectible book collection.
